headline: Support Engineer (NetOps) · Researcher
summary:
I work as a NetOps Engineer at Daffodil Online Limited (DOL), a multi-service provider under the well-known Daffodil Group. My core responsibility involves maintaining a seamless and reliable infrastructure for networks, data centers, and related services, supporting over 30,000 customers across the country.

Additionally, I serve as a part-time Research Assistant at CAMLAs, where we explore ways to uncover patterns within binaries and systems—research that has the potential to contribute to the advancement of humanity. I also write regularly on various topics, as I believe that the act of writing fosters the development of knowledge and thought.
